description: Kyrgyzstan Lakes and Reservoirs Dataset is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Hamilton, Ethan (deposited on HydroShare). The Kyrgyzstan Lakes and Reservoirs Dataset is an open, source-traceable geographic and hydrologic reference dataset covering selected lakes, reservoirs, lake complexes, and documented glacial-lake events in Kyrgyzstan. The resource combines a normalized water-body registry with source-specific morphometric measurements, including surface area, elevation, maximum depth, volume, and other attributes where available. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. The resource was created 2026-09-04 and last updated 2026-09-04; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
